text: Students already enrolled and borrowing before July twenty twenty-six keep Grad PLUS for up to three more academic years, or for the time left in their program if that is shorter. New students like Leah still have the basic federal loan, a Direct Unsubsidized loan, up to twenty thousand five hundred dollars a year and one hundred thousand dollars total, with higher limits in professional programs like medicine or law. When a program costs more than that after other aid, the rest can come from a private lender, and that's where Leah's two offers come from. Same lender, same amount, two kinds of rate.
